name: lingshu
description: 灵枢数据标注平台 monorepo

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix apps/server && npm ci --prefix apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/server && npm run lint --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/server && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:release && npm test --prefix apps/server && npm test --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/server && npm run build:check --prefix apps/web
